scenario: Prompt injection exfiltrates company files
mitigation: Tool grant + egress allowlist + injection boundary

scenario: Unapproved model provider receives confidential data
mitigation: Policy before route + egress audit

scenario: Secret content appears in traces/logs
mitigation: Sanitized telemetry + vault

scenario: External email or payment duplicated after retry
mitigation: Idempotency + reconcile unknown state

scenario: Agent escalates own privileges
mitigation: Immutable grants + delegated intersection

scenario: Malicious connector steals OAuth token
mitigation: Vault broker + scope + allowlist

scenario: Memory poisoning turns false claim into trusted fact
mitigation: Provenance + trust gate + review

scenario: Recursive delegation exhausts inference budget
mitigation: Bounded depth/steps/cost

scenario: Support staff accesses customer secrets
mitigation: No standing privileges + break-glass

mitigation: Policy enforcement, isolation and tested container restrictions

mitigation: Policy enforcement, isolation and tested container restrictions

mitigation: Policy enforcement, isolation and tested container restrictions

scenario: Forged or replayed webhook is believed or uses up a real event's ID
mitigation: Verified only in the connector worker, after storing; signature covers time and ID; inbox row written after the signature (ADR-027 D4)

scenario: Holder of a leaked webhook URL floods storage or delays genuine callbacks
mitigation: Size, rate and backlog limits on one atomic update; own small database pool; replace the endpoint (ADR-027 D4)
verification: tests/integration/webhooks.test.ts; limits not load tested until OPS-01

scenario: Connector or dependency sends a credential or data out of the stack
mitigation: Credential service on an internal network with no route out; gateway has no secret and one target (ADR-027 D5)

scenario: A person is told an email went or did not go when nobody knows
mitigation: Unknown is its own status; receipts say on whose word; a person's answer is recorded as theirs and sends nothing (ADR-027 D2 and D6)

scenario: Restore to before a send lets the same mail go twice
mitigation: Runbook keeps the connector worker stopped until unsettled intents are reviewed. The code does not enforce this; OPS-02 is the answer

scenario: Compromised web tier forges an attempt outcome or a person's resolution through the shared role
mitigation: Transition rules in triggers; web tier cannot unseal or send. A separate worker role is an open question for the outside review (ADR-027)

scenario: Tenant claims an email domain it does not own and signs in as its people through SSO
mitigation: Only the operator can verify a domain; verified domains are unique; assertions outside the domain are refused

scenario: Forged or replayed SAML assertion reaches a session
mitigation: Signed assertions required; InResponseTo on; IdP-initiated off; parser reviewed outside
verification: Automated negative security test and outside review

scenario: Application role forges an MFA proof or a privileged action skips it
mitigation: Proof table has no write grant for the application role; checked in the same transaction as the effect

scenario: Pack, graph or draft widens what an agent may do without review
mitigation: Packs are data and grant nothing; every draft binds a hash through simulation and review; the compiler refuses effects without approval

scenario: Hostile skill package reaches an agent or a tenant
mitigation: Signed manifest over every file, restricted format, table rules on verified and published, two-person publish, use-time recheck
verification: skills-schema and skill-format tests; ADR-034 D1 D2

scenario: User code escapes the sandbox or reaches a credential
mitigation: Separate runner behind an OCI runtime, network none, empty environment, no credentials, no fallback, probe before start
verification: Probe on shipped images plus outside review; ADR-034 D3

scenario: Unreviewed or forged listing reaches other tenants
mitigation: Trigger requires an approved review of this digest, signature by a key from configuration checked at listing and at every install, operator-only role
verification: skills-schema and install tests; ADR-034 D5 D6

scenario: Tenant's confidential skill shared by accident through the marketplace
mitigation: Only a package marked public can be submitted, by an owner, with explicit confirmation

scenario: Forwarded cross-org invitation reaches the wrong company
mitigation: Third consent step by the sharing owner; fingerprint; token shown once; hash only stored
verification: Automated negative security test and review

scenario: Compromised federation worker reads every shared copy
mitigation: Optional role; one grant per transaction; no business table; write-only inbound content; outside review
verification: Automated negative security test and review

scenario: Policy widened on an existing table lets a tenant reach another
mitigation: No existing policy changes; copies only; role grants test
verification: Automated negative security test and review

scenario: Revoked data remains readable or is resurrected
mitigation: Read policy asks whether the grant is open; advisory lock against racing crossings; purge workflow and ledger
verification: Automated negative security test and review

scenario: Crafted row points the worker at another tenant object key
mitigation: Object key fixed by a check constraint to the derived prefix; hash verified after copy
verification: Automated negative security test and review

scenario: Received content acts as an instruction to an agent
mitigation: Inbound items are not indexed or offered to agents; accepting starts nothing
verification: Automated negative security test and review

scenario: Tenant moves itself between tier or region
mitigation: Profile written only by the deploy job as migrator; no application grant
verification: Automated negative security test and review

scenario: Product claims isolation or residency nobody showed
mitigation: Isolated and all-in-region worked out from recorded probes and declarations; undeclared denies
verification: Automated negative security test and review
